_help: Copy this file to scripts/espn_config.json (that file is never uploaded to GitHub) and fill it in.
league_id and team_id are in your ESPN team page URL: ...?leagueId=XXXX&teamId=Y
Public league: leave espn_s2 and swid empty.
Private league: in Chrome or Edge, open fantasy.espn.com while logged in, press F12,
go to Application > Cookies > https://fantasy.espn.com, and copy the values of espn_s2 and SWID (keep the curly braces).
Treat these like a password: don't paste them into chats, screenshots or GitHub.
